full_prompt_en: This square digital collage presents a closely framed young face and the partial head of a small tabby cat within layers of leaves, flowers, and weathered color. The face occupies the center, looking slightly upward toward the left. Large blue-green eyes, a softly lit nose, and parted pink lips remain recognizable beneath translucent textures. The cat enters from the right edge, its striped forehead, pointed ear, closed eye, and pale muzzle overlapping the cheek. Around them, broad teal leaves and smaller clusters of blossoms fill nearly every margin. A vivid orange leaf rests across the top of the forehead, and another warm leaf near the left cheek interrupts the surrounding blue and violet growth. Thin branchlike marks, speckles, and fragments of distressed paint cross the skin as well as the foliage, so that neither layer stays wholly in front. The lower part of the face dissolves into dense greens, yellows, and small red flowers. Although the source portrait has smooth photographic modeling, the collage gives it a grainy, rubbed, almost printed surface. Cool turquoise and deep ultramarine dominate, with warm orange, yellow, coral, and rose scattered as small counterweights. There is no single realistic light source for all the overlapping materials; bright highlights in the eyes and central nose keep the expression vivid, while darker textured corners press the composition inward. The result is an intimate, dreamlike image in which photographic clarity and richly eroded botanical color inhabit the same shallow space.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形数字拼贴把近景的年轻面容和一只小虎斑猫的部分头部置于层叠的叶片、花朵和斑驳色彩之中。面部占据中央，目光微微朝左上方。蓝绿色的大眼睛、柔和受光的鼻部与微张的粉色嘴唇在半透明肌理下依然可辨。小猫从右边缘进入，条纹前额、尖耳、闭着的眼与浅色口鼻同面颊交叠。宽阔的青绿叶片和较小的花簇环绕两者，几乎填满每处边缘。一片鲜橙叶落在前额上方，左颊旁另一片暖色叶打断周围的蓝紫色植物。细枝般的痕迹、斑点和磨损颜料碎片同时穿过皮肤与叶丛，使任何一层都不完全固定在最前。下半张脸消融在密集绿、黄与红色小花之中。底层面容虽有平滑的摄影式明暗，拼贴却为它覆上颗粒、擦磨、近似印刷的表面。冷调绿松石色和深群青占主导，暖橙、黄、珊瑚与玫瑰色作为散落的小重音。叠合的各层并不共享一个现实光源；眼睛和鼻部中央的亮点维持鲜活表情，更暗的肌理角落则把构图向内收拢。最终画面亲密而梦幻，摄影式清晰与丰厚的磨蚀植物色彩共处同一浅空间。
style_prompt_en: Layered digital collage lets a softly modeled photographic base show through translucent fields of distressed paint and fine organic pattern. Edges repeatedly dissolve, reappear, and overlap, replacing conventional depth with a shallow woven surface. Saturated turquoise, indigo, and blue-green make a cool continuous ground; brief orange, coral, yellow, and rose accents create lively interruptions. Fine speckling, rubbed patches, and small branching marks carry texture across boundaries between otherwise separate layers. Local highlights keep a chosen focal zone clear while darker, denser margins draw attention inward. The visual effect is lush and dreamlike, balancing recognizable realism with an almost printed, weathered density.
style_prompt_zh: 层叠数字拼贴让柔和塑造的摄影底层透过半透明的磨损色域和细密有机纹样显现。边缘反复消融、重现并交叠，以浅而交织的表面取代常规纵深。饱和绿松石色、靛蓝与蓝绿构成连续冷底；短促的橙、珊瑚、黄与玫瑰色形成活泼的打断。细斑点、擦磨区域和小型分枝痕迹跨越原本分开的层次延续肌理。局部高光使选定焦点保持清晰，较暗且密集的边缘则把注意力拉向内部。视觉效果丰盛而梦幻，在可辨认的真实感与近似印刷品的陈旧密度之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A blue-eyed face and a small cat woven into a saturated botanical collage
theme_zh: 蓝眼面容与小猫交织在浓艳植物拼贴中的画面
name: Alaya Gadeh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
